svg.title: @sparse · Synthetic sample
svg.desc: Isometric contribution terrain for @sparse from 2025-01-05 to 2026-01-03. 72 contributions across 35 active days. 0 wonders discovered. relative normalization, maximum 3.

g.aria-label: Contribution height legend. Relative scale from 0 to 3 contributions. Five increasing bars represent terrain height. Terrain colors follow the seasons.

g.aria-label: Calendar timeline from 2025-01-05 to 2026-01-03. Month and season cues follow supplied contribution dates.
